demo.cliff: software points at its host by id
teaches: subType: software is what turns an item Item into a program; the software block is dead weight on any other sub-type.
bandwidth is what the program wants, runAt what it has been told to settle for, and effect the sentence describing what it does.
software.computerId holds the id of a host Item embedded on the SAME Actor — a computer, or an equipped armour or fitted augment carrying a Processing figure.
demo.trap: computerId is blank here because this copy is loose in a compendium and there is no Actor for it to resolve against. runAt below bandwidth is a stored choice and never a derivation: 2 under a bandwidth of 3 makes downgraded come out true, and nothing recomputes runAt when the bandwidth changes. A SPACECRAFT does not use this graph at all — its budget is system.computer.processing and its started programs are ids in system.computer.running. See the Demo — Kestrel-class Courier.

system.description: Reads a tide chart against a sounding and tells you where the channel moved. Rated for three, run at two.

software.effect: DM+1 on any check to navigate a tidal channel, and DM+2 with a fresh sounding.
